The object really does that; in this source that index is out of bounds and driving it is UB in OUR code rather than a differential trial (D561's rule), so the grid stops at 63 and no runnable input separates them.  Held fixed by the encoding alone, and recorded as such: docs/deviations.md D680.  If this ever starts being caught, someone has added a trial that overruns the row -- which wants looking at before it is believed.
